notes.title: Deathless Is Now Officially SteamDeck Verified
notes.content:
Deathless has got official verification—the game is now adapted to SteamDeck! 

Valve has checked the game and approved it: everything works in a stable, comfortable, and beautiful fashion. From UI to controls—every element has been adjusted for the comfort of portable gaming:
[list]
[*] [b]Full compatibility[/b]: UI, scale, and text are adjusted to the device screen

[*] [b]Cloud savings[/b]: start your journey on a PC and continue anywhere you like
[/list]

notes.title: Dark fantasy deckbuilder Deathless gets a new name as its final update lands
notes.content:
Transpose the deckbuilding core of games like Slay the Spire into a dark fantasy setting, with art and creature designs inspired by classic RPGs and DnD, and inject a little of the positional combat trickery of Darkest Dungeon, and you have Deathless: The Hero Quest. Formerly known by a different subtitle, Tales of Old Rus, the roguelike now has a new name as developer 1C Game Studios delivers its conclusive, final update, including visual upgrades, a fresh opening cinematic, and a dangerous new opponent.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1: Rebalancing, Camera Settings, and Other Changes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 is now live! The main changes include new combat camera settings, a new card layout, and hero, foe, and relic rebalancing.

[h3]1.0.1 Patch Notes[/h3]

Font size increased on Steam Deck

Combat camera settings 
Dynamic: zoomed in, depth-of-field effect
Balanced: not zoomed in, depth-of-field effect
Static: not zoomed in, no depth-of-field effect

In combat, cards can either be dealt in a straight line or fanned out

The number of Prestige points earned at the end of a journey has been changed
- Winning an ordinary battle now earns you 10 Prestige rather than 5
- Defeating an ordinary boss now earns you 40, 80, or 120 Prestige for level 1, 2, and 3 respectively rather than 50 for all levels

Rebalanced foes
Koschey the Deathless:
- The Summon the Gloom intention no longer makes Koschey invulnerable to debuffs, but it can be used multiple times per battle
- Koschey regains 2/3 of his health when the battle moves to phase 2 and 1/3 when it moves to phase 3
- Every time the battle moves to a new phase, Koschey loses all debuffs, moves to the back position, and becomes invulnerable to buffs until the next round
- The Koschey’s Curse effect now stacks when the deck is reshuffled and does not decrease

Chudo Yudo now deals 4 damage instead of 5
Barker no longer uses the Dreadful Howl intention when left alone on the battlefield
Heretnik battle (step 14): one Striga has been replaced by a Slave Ghoul
For some battles, the range of steps at which they can be encountered has been changed

Rebalanced relics
- The Wooden Stake now grants Vigor x3 instead of 2
- The Birchbark Shoes are now Uncommon instead of Rare
- The Broken Mirror now applies Dizzy x2 instead of 1
- The Silver Dagger now activates at 12 cards instead of 10
The Clapper’s effect boost has been reduced from 2 to 1
- The Bell is now Rare instead of Uncommon and grants 2 AP instead of 1
- The Amber Charm now grants +25% Health instead of +20%
- The Golden Rose now grants 30 Gold instead of 25
- The Juicy Apple now grants Vigor x3 instead of 2

Rebalanced consumables
- Oak Moss now grants Resilience x4 instead of 3
- Goldroot now grants x5 Crimson Gold instead of 2
- Hopping Herb is now Rare instead of Epic
- Parsley is now Epic instead of Rare

Rebalanced Varvara’s cards
Note: the numbers in round brackets stand for the upgraded version of the card.

- Agility now costs 1(0) AP instead of 1(1) and grants Agility x2(2) instead of 2(3)
- Cleave now deals 7(9) damage instead of 5(7)
- Tactical Arrangement now costs 2(1) AP instead of 1(0) and applies Perplexed to all foes
- Fighting Back now deals 3(5) damage instead of 2(4)
- Fury now grants Vigor x2(3) instead of 2(2)
- Fair Share now steals 3(5) Armor instead of 2(3)
- Opportunism now grants an additional 1(2) Armor
- Vulnerable now costs 1(0) AP instead of 1(1) and applies Vulnerable x2(2) instead of 2(3)
- Piercing Strike now deals 6(6) damage instead of 5(5)
- Hiding now costs 2(2) AP instead of 2(1) and inflicts Dizzy x1(2) instead of 1(1)
Double Down! now costs 2(1) AP instead of 2(2)
- Dizziness now costs 1(0) AP instead of 1(1) and inflicts Dizzy x2(2) instead of 2(3)
- Scramble now applies Dizzy x2(3) instead of 1(2)
- Bestowal now costs 3(3) AP instead of 4(4)

Rebalanced Vasilisa’s cards
- Grand Entrance now costs 3(2) AP instead of 2(2) and deals 3(3) damage instead of 2(3)
- Absolution now deals 4(6) damage instead of 5(7)
- Cataclysm now costs 2(2) AP instead of 4(4), deals 2(3) damage instead of 4(6), and resets the Nursemaid’s charges when used
- Eagerness now grants 2(2) extra charges instead of 1(1)
- I’ve Got This! — updated description: draw 1(2) card(s) and gain 2 AP for every charged Nursemaid on the battlefield. Reset their charges. Forget this card
- Bare Essentials now grants 1(2) card(s) from the Draw Deck (you could choose fewer cards before)

Rebalanced Dobrynya’s cards
- Forgotten Armor has been renamed to Forgotten Weapon and is now Rare instead of Epic. Also, it now allows you to forget as many attack cards as you want (you used to forget all the attacks in your hand)
- Whirlwind of Steel is now Rare instead of Epic and costs 2(2) AP instead of 4(3). New description: deal 3(5) damage and inflict Burned x2(4) on all foes on the battlefield. This card is Constant
- Clean Sweep is now Rare instead of Epic and costs 2(1) AP instead of X(X). New description: deal 3(3) damage. If you have Rampage, double the damage
- Screams of the Fallen now costs 1(1) AP instead of 2(2)
- Lightweight is now Rare instead of Epic. New description: gain 1 AP if your Armor is 5(3) or higher
- For Belosvet! is now Rare instead of Epic and costs 2(1) AP instead of 3(3). New description: deal 3(5) damage. Discard all Skills from your hand and draw the same number of cards
- Rock is now Uncommon instead of Rare
- Crush is now Uncommon instead of Rare, costs 1(1) AP instead of 2(2), deals 1(1) damage instead of 3(3), and is no longer Constant
- Deadly Defense now grants 1(2) base Armor instead of 1(1)
- Indomitable is now Rare instead of Epic and costs 3(2) AP instead of 4(3)
- Ramming Shield is now Uncommon instead of Rare
- Repose is now Rare instead of Epic and costs 2(1) AP instead of 3(2)
- Rampage now grants Vigor x2(2) instead of 1(1)
- Survival now grants 1(2) Armor instead of 1(1)
- Stoneskin is now Rare instead of Epic
- In Cold Blood is now Uncommon instead of Rare, costs 1(1) AP instead of 2(2), and deals 2(3) damage instead of 3(5)
- Turn the Tide now costs 2(1) AP instead of 3(3) and works differently: Deal 3(5) damage. You may discard up to 2 cards of your choice from your hand and draw the same number of cards
- Stronghold is now Rare instead of Epic
- Finish the Fight is now Rare instead of Epic
- Heroic Might is now Rare instead of Epic
- Azure Peak Shield is now Rare instead of Uncommon
- Bounty Hunt now grants 1(2) max. health instead of 1(1)
- Bogatyr’s Shield is now Rare instead of Uncommon
- Bloodletting is now Epic instead of Rare and deals X(X+2) damage instead of X(X+1)
- Stratagem is now Rare instead of Uncommon
- Sick and Tired is now Epic instead of Rare
- Trophy Weapon now deals 5(5) damage instead of 5(7)
- Hand of Destiny is now Epic instead of Rare
- Wrath now costs 3(2) AP instead of 2(1) and grants Vigor x4(4) instead of 3(3)
- Snapped in Half is now Rare instead of Epic, costs 2(1) AP instead of 3(2). New description: deal 3(3) damage. Deal +1 damage for each stack of Fortified you have. This card is Constant

- Blinded effect: foes’ attacks no longer inflict debuffs, add statuses, etc.

- Follow-Up Strike now costs 2(2) AP instead of 2(1), and its upgraded version is now a Starter. New description: gain Strength x1 upon vanquishing a foe
- Infinite Charges now costs 3(2) AP instead of 2(2), and its upgraded version is no longer a Starter
- Blessing of Kitezh now costs 4(3) AP instead of 2(2), and its upgraded version is now a Starter. New description: gain Stopping Power x2 at the start of the turn
- Foolhardy now costs 2(2) AP instead of 3(2), and its upgraded version is now Retained
- Ablaze now costs 3(3) AP instead of 3(2), and its upgraded version is no longer a Starter
- Rusty Shield now applies Hindrance instead of Wound
- Burn Bright now costs 1(0) AP instead of 1(1). New description: double the Burned stacks on the nearest Burned foe. Increase this card’s cost by 1
- Heat Lightning now costs 3(2) AP instead of 3(3) and grants Spark x2(2) instead of 2(3)
- Total Recall now plays the selected Spellbane card for free
- Sure Shot — updated description: mark the nearest living foe. If there is another Marked foe on the battlefield, apply another Mark


Miscellaneous

- Updated the hints that appear on the path selection screen when using a controller

- Alyosha: changed the VFX for Blind, Overheat, and Mark

- Hoarder: changed the VFX for the Rockfall intention

- Vasilisa: added a VFX when a Nursemaid gains or loses charges

- Updated the journey difficulty selection screen

- Added a tutorial for the different kinds of card highlights

- Added hero status panel to the stats screen at the end of the journey

- Added burning animation to unselected pages

- Reordered options in general and gameplay settings

- You can now use a healing consumable from the rewards screen if there isn’t enough room for it in the inventory

- Changed the way cards are sorted on deck interaction screens:
- when transforming and deleting cards, they are sorted from oldest to newest
- when upgrading cards, they are sorted from newest to oldest

- Bosorka, Two-Souled Bosorka, Kegra, Yaron: ranged attack projectile speed increased

- Alyosha: Overheat VFX is now also displayed at the start of the turn if Overheat is greater than 0

- Reduced the number of monsters you have to kill for Hero’s Path quests

- Desynchronized identical card VFX



Bug fixes:

- Fixed a bug that caused the “End turn” button to display incorrectly during the foe’s turn

- Freezing Blast (Alyosha): fixed the way Vanquish works against Marked foes

- The Agility effect (Varvara) no longer allows the Koschey’s Curse effect to ignore Armor when applied to the hero

- Foolhardy+ (Alyosha) is no longer a Starter

- Swamper: fixed the Swamp Sorcery intention icon

- Leshy: Oak Bark is now reset to 1 stack at the start of the turn

- Koschey: ability SFX no longer fails to play when replaying the battle

- Fixed the size of effect tooltips when they refer to a card
- Type and rarity added to relic and consumable descriptions; button color fixed

- The Bestiary no longer closes automatically at the end of a battle

- Sash of Seven Silks relic no longer glows constantly outside of battle

- Stand Back! card: the game no longer freezes if you finish your turn before the animation of cards being added to your hand is complete

- All-Around Defense effect (Dobrynya): the activation SFX no longer plays every time the hero attacks

- Nettle Shirt relic now allows you to remove just one card (you had to remove two cards before)

- Mighty Blow (Dobrynya) no longer deals twice the indicated damage when its condition is met

- For Good Measure (Alyosha): effect description fixed

- Werewolf Berserker: the description of the Entranced effect now indicates that it prevents the foe from being Vanquished

- Fervor (Vasilisa): adjusted the description

- Cateye Stone relic: updated the description of the Confused effect

- Tactician (Varvara): adjusted the description

- Kitezh Charm relic: if the hero has the Quiver relic, the blinding animation no longer plays twice

- Settings: when you highlight an option with a controller, its description is now displayed

- You can now create a backup copy of the player’s profile

- Consumables: fixed a bug that caused consumables used during dialog to do nothing

- Merchant: fixed a bug that caused the upgrade previews of cards for sale to display incorrectly

- The icons in card descriptions no longer disappear when the game’s resolution is changed 

- Fixed the arrangement of tooltips on the Prestige card selection screen
- Burned effect: updated the description in card tooltips

- Stalwart Spirit (Dobrynya): fixed a bug that caused more damage to be dealt to the hero than indicated

- Gird Your Loins (Dobrynya) no longer applies a debuff when played

- Adjusted the hint that appears when selecting help before a boss fight

- Gorynich: the Mark VFX is now removed properly when the player vanquishes one of the heads

[*] Virovnik

Recommendations before switching to the beta version:

Make a backup of your saves. Here’s how:
Press the Win + R keys, paste C:\Users\%Username%\AppData\LocalLow\1CGS\Deathless in the window that appears, and press Enter.
Copy the contents of the folder to another location.
When returning to the standard version of the game, replace the files with the saved ones.
Please disable cloud saves for the game (Steam Cloud). This can be done in the game properties, under the "General" tab.
How to join the open beta test:

Open Steam and right-click on "Deathless".
Select "Properties..." and go to the "Betas" tab.
Select the branch named public_beta from the dropdown menu.
Now you can choose this branch as the main one on your computer. You can play after updating the client.

How to get game logs:
Press the Win + R keys, paste C:\Users\%Username%\AppData\LocalLow\1CGS\Deathless in the window that appears, and press Enter.
In the opened folder, select all files and add them to a single archive. You can use the free program 7-Zip for this.
Upload the archive to any file-sharing service and send the link.

[*] The journey has been extended from 18 to 21 steps

notes.title: Beta Update: New Interface
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we’ve prepared a major update for the beta-branch. The most important part of this update is the new interface, specifically:

[list][*] The hero selection interface has been updated.
[*] The Merchant interface has been updated.
[*] The combat interface has been updated.
[*] The reward screen interface after winning a battle has been updated.
[*] A notification has been added to indicate why a reward is blocked after winning a battle.
[*] The Hero Path interface has been updated.[/list]

We want to note that the interface is a very important part of any game. It should be native understandable, free of visual clutter, and, of course, user-friendly. We had many discussions and debates while working on it, so we now ask you to provide feedback on the new interface. You can do this in the comments or on Discord.

Additionally, 4 random events have been added, several visual effects have been introduced, and a number of issues have been resolved.

How to join the open beta test:
[list]
[*] Open Steam and right-click on "Deathless".
[*] Select "Properties..." and go to the "Betas" tab.
[*] Select the branch named public_beta from the dropdown menu.
[*] Now you can choose this branch as the main one on your computer. You can play after updating the client.
[*] If you find a bug, please send it along with the log to this thread (or via email).
[/list]
How to get game logs:
[list]
[*] Press the Win + R keys, paste C:\Users\%Username%\AppData\LocalLow\1CGS\Deathless in the window that appears, and press Enter.
[*] In the opened folder, select all files and add them to a single archive. You can use the free program 7-Zip for this.
[*] Upload the archive to any file-sharing service and send the link.
[*] Or send it to support@1cccp.ru with a brief description of the issue.
[/list]

notes.content:
Werewolves are here!

[*] Adjusted the description for Transform Card to clarify that a card can be transformed into another card of the same type

notes.title: Deathless. Tales of Old Rus Launches Into Steam Early Access
notes.content:
Discover the world of Belosvet in Deathless. Tales of Old Rus. Set out on an epic journey with heroes inspired by Slavic folklore, experience their stories, and eventually save your homeland from an invasion by Koschey the Deathless.

[previewyoutube=dq0J9rMKtr8;full][/previewyoutube]
In the complete version of Deathless. Tales of Old Rus four heroes will be available. While starting the EA you play Varvara The Fair, crafty and cunning in equal measure, the treasure hunter wields her trusty pickaxe and enchanted braid in battle. Two additional heroes will be introduced during the EA period.
No two journeys in Deathless. Tales of Old Rus are the same, as the game features deep strategic variety, combat modifiers, and exciting secrets to uncover. 

Deathless. Tales of Old Rus inspired by games like Slay the Spire  is set in Belosvet, a fantasy world home to bogatyrs, wizards, and sorcerers, amusing little spirits known as nechistiks, and myriad creatures most foul. The world of Belosvet is inspired by Slavic folklore and has been carefully and lovingly redesigned by artist and author Roman Papsuev, the best artist of Europe in 2008 according to the Eurocon convention.

The game also features music from leading composer Dmitri Silantyev, who is known for his work on Pathfinder: Kingmaker, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, Armored Warfare, and Skyforge. 

[b]Game Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] A Whole New World: The first video game adaptation of the original universe by artist Roman Papsuev and featuring music by acclaimed composer Dmitriy Silantyev. 

[*] Fearsome Fairytale Foes: Clash with revenants and khuds, fight a yaga, chat with a vodyanoy, and even befriend rusalkas… or maybe not — those sneaky water nymphs are deadly foes.

[*] Play Again and Again: Highly replayable gameplay complete with combat modifiers and strategic variety.

[*] Triumphant victory or crushing defeat?: Unlock new cards and battle modifiers by the end of each playthrough to make your future runs even more exciting.

[*] A unique path for each hero: Watch as the heroes’ tales intertwine in surprising ways. Complete quests, meet memorable allies, and confront inimitable foes. Defeating bosses will prove to be quite the challenge.

[/list]
